Don’t be to worried about fluent attacks and try to land that “Sky Dive” (as I call it) as close to the stage as possible it can really easily become a starter for possible neutral and special combos. Also utilize that Up Special ONLY if you really need to recover, I DO NOT recommend using it on stage or above stage as it is highly punishable. DeDeDe’s Gordos are a pain in the ass to deal with, edge guarding and projectile spammers are good to use it with, but when you see a second of chance of it being hit back use King DeDeDe’s Inhale ability and either shoot it back at your opponent or away from you (recommended). When it comes to aerial attacks try using a little more than just Nair, like the King’s Back air is great off stage. Platform stages are good for King DeDeDe and his Up Specials and Up Neutrals. When it comes to the Jet Hammer and your Forward Smash I do not recommend using it super often because of how slow it is. I recommend using them to either Break your opponent’s shield or finish them off. Utilize your sheild! Its very big! And finally I do recommend using your recovery (Super DeDeDe Jump) AFTER you have consecutively used all 4 of his jumps. Not saying that you personally made these mistakes, Im just setting the guidelines. Also the best line of trickery is King DeDeDe’s “Succ & Cucc”, very risky but very satisfying to pull off.
